content_text:
Hello Roger,
I am tasked with shooting several days in this high-rise office interior. I will need to see out the windows, and due to its height do all of my lighting from the interior. Do you have advice on an approach for balancing the interior to the exterior and attempting to keep consistent lighting over a dozen days? Or, if you’ve been in a similar lighting situation how did you handle it?
Thanks for all your amazing feedback in these forums!
